tools.name: privacy-operations_policy-structure-audit
tools.description: List headings and Section lines in a supplied policy and compare them with the sections the caller marks as required. Headings are still listed when a required section is absent. A missing section is a gap in the document, not a legal conclusion. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/privacy-operations/pol

tools.name: privacy-operations_personal-data-inventory-extract
tools.description: Copy categories, purposes, stated legal bases, and retention periods from Category fields. Prose is not mined for categories, and a stated basis is not assessed. Price $0.04 USDC. tools.name: privacy-operations_data-retention-policy-check
tools.description: Read retention periods stated by the caller. A period counts only as days, months, years, account lifetime, or until deletion. Months are not converted to days, and no statutory period is invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/privacy-operations/data-retention-policy-check. An unpaid call returns

tools.name: privacy-operations_notice-consistency-check
tools.description: Compare purpose, stated basis, and retention for the same category in a supplied policy and notice. A difference is reported and neither document is chosen. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/privacy-operations/notice-consistency-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: privacy-operations_cookie-consent-configuration-audit
tools.description: Read cookie purpose, duration, and the consent state supplied by the caller. An optional cookie without an opt-in or opt-out state is reported. tools.name: privacy-operations_data-subject-request-classify
tools.description: Match a supplied request type to access, deletion, correction, export, objection, or restriction. Any other wording is left unrecognized. No response deadline is calculated. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/privacy-operations/data-subject-request-classify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "privacy-operations" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: privacy-operations_policy-structure-audit, privacy-operations_data-retention-policy-check, privacy-operations_notice-consistency-check, privacy-operations_cookie-consent-configuration-audit, privacy-operations_data-deletion-evidence-check · Private data: privacy-operations_policy-structure-audit, privacy-operations_notice-consistency-check, privacy-operations_data-deletion-evidence-check · Public sink: privacy-operations_policy-structure-audit, privacy-operations_personal-data-inventory-extract, privacy-operations_data-retention-policy-check, privacy-operations_notice-consistency-check, privacy-operations_cookie-consent-configuration-audit, privacy-operations_data-subject-request-classify, privacy-operations_data-deletion-evidence-check, privacy-operations_documentation-report · Destructive: privacy-operations_policy-structure-audit, privacy-operations_personal-data-inventory-extract, privacy-operations_data-retention-policy-check, privacy-operations_notice-consistency-check, privacy-operations_cookie-consent-configuration-audit, privacy-operations_data-subject-request-classify, privacy-operations_data-deletion-evidence-check, privacy-operations_documentation-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
